$comment: PocketAI model + runtime configuration. All paths are RELATIVE to the PocketAI root so the USB drive letter can change (E:/F:/G:). 'auto' values are resolved by the launcher at startup. This file is the single source of truth; runtime/*.bat mirror these values for manual use.

model.name: Qwen3.5-4B Instruct
model.notes: Hybrid SSM+Attention (full_attention_interval=4). Small KV cache; SSM layers use fixed-size recurrent state.

runtime.threads_note: Physical cores, detected at launch. Avoids SMT/logical cores which usually hurt llama.cpp.
runtime.n_gpu_layers_note: CPU-only on target (no NVIDIA). Dev profile may override to offload to GPU.
runtime.flash_attention_note: -fa on. Reduces RAM for the KV cache; validated for qwen35 CPU in build 10549.
runtime.load_mode_note: llama.cpp --load-mode (replaces deprecated --mmap/--mlock). auto = mmap unless unsupported.

server.port_note: 8091 chosen to avoid common conflicts (8080 Oracle/proxies, 11434 Ollama, 1234 LM Studio).
server.api_key_note: Local-only obfuscation key, not a real secret: prevents other local processes / web pages from using the model API. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'.
